Official Statement – Blanco Nails Mahagedara On Sunday, 31st August 2025, Ms. Ireshani Perera requested an appointment for 2nd September 2025 at 10:00 AM. As our salon operates strictly on an appointment basis, we reserved this time slot for her. At 10:15 AM, we called to check on her delay, and she informed us that she was travelling from Negombo and would arrive late. She eventually arrived at 11:00 AM, one hour past the scheduled appointment. Although this directly impacted our later bookings, we accommodated her without complaint, respecting her travel distance. Upon arrival, she brought two friends and attempted to seat them at the pedicure workstation. Our salon has a spacious and comfortable client waiting area, but according to our strict policies—based on professionalism, client comfort, and past experiences—waiting guests are not permitted near workstations (nail tables, pedicure chairs, facial beds, or waxing rooms). This ensures privacy, focus, and the highest quality of service. When we politely explained this policy, Ms. Perera became upset and stated she would leave if her request was not met. Despite our efforts to handle the matter respectfully, she chose to leave without receiving any service. As per our salon policy, clients who cancel or leave after occupying appointment slots are subject to a cancellation fee, as their actions result in a loss of valuable business time. We have since noticed that Ms. Perera has a record of leaving negative reviews for several other salons, hotels, and businesses. We wish to make it clear that Blanco Nails Mahagedara is committed to maintaining professionalism, respecting our clients, and delivering high-quality services. However, we will not tolerate unfair reviews that misrepresent the truth and damage our reputation. Our salon is not a café or social hangout space—it is a professional environment where artistry, skill, and client experience are our top priorities. We kindly request all clients to respect our policies and the time of our staff, as this ensures fairness for every appointment. Team Blanco Nails Mahagedara

Dear Clients, Followers & Future Clients, We would like to clarify the situation regarding this review, as several statements made in it are misleading and do not accurately reflect what happened during the appointment. First, we want to make it clear that the hair was not cut without the client’s consent, as stated in the review. The client was clearly informed about the condition of her hair and the limitations of performing another rebonding treatment on previously chemically processed and damaged sections. During the consultation, we initially recommended Keratin Treatment for the previously rebonded lengths, as applying rebonding chemicals again to already processed hair could cause significant damage. However, the client specifically stated that she did not want Keratin and wanted a very straight, flat result, so she requested rebonding. Our professional recommendation was therefore to perform rebonding only on the virgin/new-growth area, where it could be done safely. We explained that the previously rebonded lengths had already been chemically processed at another salon and that we could not safely rebond those sections again. The client agreed to this recommendation, and the rebonding was successfully completed on the regrowth area. Regarding the ends, the client herself agreed to have the damaged/frizzy portion cut. The haircut was not done without her permission. We have CCTV footage and other clients who were present at the salon who can verify what took place. After the haircut, the client later asked about rebonding the remaining ends. We explained that we could look at doing it carefully, but she said she did not have enough time that day and would return another day. She subsequently made another appointment for the following week to continue with the treatment. Therefore, the statement that we simply cut her hair without consent, refused to help her, or deliberately caused her to lose her hair length is not an accurate representation of what happened. We completely understand that a client may be unhappy with the final result or may have different expectations. However, we believe it is important that our existing clients, future clients, and followers also have the opportunity to know the full and accurate circumstances before forming an opinion based on a one-sided review. We stand behind our professional consultation and the decisions made to protect the client’s hair from further chemical damage. We have supporting evidence regarding the consultation and events that took place. If anyone genuinely wishes to understand what happened, you are welcome to contact House of Aura Luxe directly, and we will explain the situation transparently. We respect every client and always aim to provide professional advice based on the condition of the hair—not simply perform a treatment that could potentially cause further damage. Thank you to all our loyal clients who continue to trust House of Aura Luxe. ❤️ House of Aura Luxe (Pvt) Ltd 📍 266, Depanama, Pannipitiya 📞 0711 90 17 17 Enhance Your Aura ✨ UPDATE Furthermore, although we stand by our professional work and the consultation provided, we genuinely wanted to resolve the client’s dissatisfaction. As a gesture of goodwill, we offered her a complimentary session to address the remaining areas and work towards achieving the result she wanted, subject to what could be safely done based on the condition of her hair. However, despite this offer, we have not received any response from her regarding the complimentary session. We believe this is also important for our clients and followers to know, as our intention has always been to communicate openly, provide professional advice, and make every reasonable effort to resolve any genuine concern.
